sign_up.terms_content:
By using FruitHUB, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

1. All fruits are provided subject to local market availability.
2. Customers must ensure the accuracy of delivery details before confirming an order.
3. Payment is upon delivery or via the electronic methods available in the app.
4. FruitHUB reserves the right to adjust prices or offers at any time without prior notice.
5. Return and exchange policy is subject to conditions that preserve the freshness and quality of products.
6. By using the app, you agree to our privacy policy and data protection terms.
